title: Customer integrations briefing — Needlepoint week 29
body:
Meeting: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services weekly sync
Date: 2029-07-23 10:00 AM PT
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Liam O'Connor, Priya Singh, Evan Park, Sofia Ramos, Anya Novak (SRE), Rob Hsu (Customer Success)
Duration: 45 min

Agenda:
- Quick wins / escalations since last sync (5m)
- Customer status round robin (25m)
- Deployment and infra risks (10m)
- Prioritized action items & owners (5m)

Notes / Highlights:
1) Quick wins / escalations
- Clearstream integration completed schema handshake; test corpus ingestion success, production canary scheduled for 7/26. Owner: Priya.
- Small latency regression in dedicated pool discovered after new kernel push; first mitigation is to pin previous kernel on affected nodes while SRE investigates. SRE owner: Anya. Ticket: PROSERV-1987.

2) Customer status (round robin)
- Clearstream (onboarding):
  - Status: internal verification OK. Canary windows booked 7/26–7/28 for 2x traffic.
  - Open risk: SSO attribute mapping for group claims not standardized; engineering fix required to support optional claim names. Impact: delayed role-based routing for first release.
  - Next steps: Priya to deliver patch for flexible attribute parsing by 7/25. QA: Evan.

- AtlasHealth (dedicated + private pilot):
  - Status: infra prep complete; private control plane deployed to customer VPC in staging.
  - Blocker: KMS integration failing on HSM handshake during nightly rotations — logs show intermittent timeout to partner HSM.
  - Mitigation: fallback to software KMS in staging until HSM vendor patch applied; Prod rotation remains gated.
  - Owners: Liam (infra lead), Rob (customer liaison).

- Pinegate (hosted API, embeddings heavy):
  - Status: token spend ramped higher than expected; Optimize recommended caching and batching adjustments reduced unit cost ~18% in perf env.
  - Blocker: several prompt templates trigger hallucination regression vs baseline evals after model swap to v2.1.
  - Decision: hold model swap for Pinegate; create eval suite with failing cases and run sweep. Owner: Evan.

- Meridian Retail (canary + rollout):
  - Status: Canary at 10% for new reranking model. Early metrics show slight drop in throughput at tail latencies.
  - Root cause hypothesis: KV cache miss storms due to shorter-than-expected prompt prefix reuse.
  - Next: Ops to enable aggressive KV prefetch smoothing in canary cluster. SRE owner: Anya. Rollback threshold: 95th pct latency +1.5x baseline.

3) Deployment & infra risks
- Dedicated pool capacity: current forecasted capacity for August shows 12% headroom; we should confirm reservation requests from two incoming customers (internal ticket PROSERV-1994). Action: Liam to run capacity forecast by 7/25.
- Kernel rollout: last week's optimized kernel (k3.7) caused the latency regression for specific transformer shapes. Rollback staged for affected pools; release engineering to add per-arch canary gating. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
- Network peering for private deployments: intermittent BGP flap observed between us and AtlasHealth partner edge; networking to open vendor ticket and enable session dampening. Owner: Liam.

4) Customer escalations and support notes
- Pinegate hallucination regression is highest priority for customer experience; need evals and small AB test rather than full rollback. Evan to produce failing prompt set and run head-to-head on v2.0 vs v2.1 by 7/26.
- Clearstream SSO mapping: propose small compatibility shim in our SDK for immediate unblock; longer term we add claims mapping UI in Console. Priya to prototype shim by 7/25.

5) Action items (prioritized)
- Priya: deliver Clearstream attribute parsing patch + test plan (due 2029-07-25).
- Evan: build Pinegate eval suite, run sweeps, and propose AB plan (due 2029-07-26).
- Liam: capacity forecast for Aug + open vendor ticket for AtlasHealth BGP flap (due 2029-07-25).
- Anya: apply KV prefetch smoothing on Meridian canary cluster and monitor tail latency (due 2029-07-24).
- Rob: confirm Clearstream canary window and customer-facing comms draft (due 2029-07-24).
- Maya: coordinate release engineering gating for k3.7 rollback and confirm affected pools (due 2029-07-24).

Decisions logged:
- Hold Pinegate model swap until evals complete.
- Use software KMS in staging for AtlasHealth while HSM vendor patch is pursued.

Risks flagged for leadership:
- If kernel regressions persist, several canaries may need rollback causing delayed feature rollouts; this increases risk for customers on dedicated pools in August.
- KMS/HSM rotation failures could block production rotations if vendor fix delays >2 weeks; prepare support plan with legal for emergency workaround if customer Qs escalate.

Follow-ups / Notes-to-self:
- Add a short “eviction and KV cache patterns” doc to share with customers who have low prefix reuse. Draft by Maya + Anya.
- Ask Optimize team for automated batching tuning recipe for Pinegate usage pattern; loop in Evan.

Appendix (quick links):
- PROSERV-1987 (kernel latency regression)
- SE-4421 (Pinegate eval & AB testing)
- Infra PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123

Next meeting: 2029-07-30 10:00 AM PT
